summary: Frontend-only phone polish audit (CloudIVR) at 390x844 (iPhone UA), 412x915 (Android UA) and desktop 1920. PASS: no page-level horizontal overflow on landing/login/signup/sip and all app pages (home, numbers, number detail, buy voice/texting/fax, wallet, messages, esim, settings, fax); all text inputs computed font-size >=16px; main has 16px side padding and 160px bottom padding so bottom tab bar never covers CTAs; skeleton loader (loading-indicator.civr-skel-page / skeleton cards) shown on bottom-nav navigation with slowed API, zero spinners in main; landing eSIM checkout, web-texting checkout and command palette open as full-width bottom sheets (radius 20px top, grab handle, overflow-y auto, max-height) and close with Escape; desktop 1920 dialogs stay centered; install banner appears at ~15s on iPhone UA (landing + app), sits above the tab bar, close sets localStorage civr-install-dismissed and stays hidden after reload, not shown on desktop; admin tables (fax daily, users, caller IDs, overview) render as labelled cards (all td[data-label]); desktop tables remain display:table; desktop landing/app home/buy/wallet unchanged. FAILS listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: Confirm dialog is NOT a bottom sheet: role=alertdialog without data-state matches none of the sheet selectors. Measured at 390: left 16/right 374, bottom 828 (16px gap), radius 12px, no grab handle. Repro: /cloudivr/app/numbers → number-card-0-switch-fax → confirm-dialog. Fix in mobile-app.css: add `[role="alertdialog"][aria-modal="true"]` to the sheet rule + ::before handle rule, and to the parent rule `.civr div:has(> [role="alertdialog"][aria-modal="true"])` (removes the p-4 on confirm-dialog-backdrop).

Card conversion breaks the feature-comparison matrix: table keeps Tailwind min-w-[560px] so cards are 560px wide inside a 340px overflow-x-auto box (values/ticks off-screen, needs horizontal scroll) and the table becomes 5583px tall (every feature row repeats Feature/Basic/Starter/Pro/Business labels with tiny ticks). Repro: /cloudivr/sip at 390 → sip-compare-toggle. Fix: add className `civr-keep-table` to sip-compare-table (and to landing plan-compare-table / PlanTable.js, same matrix type) so they keep the original sticky-column scroll layout.

Page horizontal overflow at 390 and 412 (documentElement.scrollWidth = 603): the User cell's email div (text-xs text-[#a1a1aa]) doesn't wrap because td is display:flex and its children have no min-width:0 / word-break. Fix: `.civr table:not(.civr-keep-table) td > * { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }`.

ui_bugs.component: Card cells with several children (admin eSIM plans table, Users name+email)
ui_bugs.issue: td display:flex + justify-content:space-between lays every child element out side by side, so multi-part cells scatter horizontally (e.g. 'SPENZA_001' next to 'SpenzaJ · physical SIM', 'Your cost $7.00 plan/mo line $3.00 (SIM_J)' overflows to x=454 at 412). Fix: make td a 2-col grid (`display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(5.5rem,38%) 1fr`) with `td > * { grid-column: 2 }` so value children stack in one column.

Grab handle not visible: ::before uses margin -4px auto 12px but palette has no top padding and overflow, so the handle is clipped/hugs the edge. Add padding-top (e.g. `.civr [data-testid=palette]{padding-top:10px}` on phones) or use margin 8px auto.

Banner (z-60, bottom 80px, 688-764px at 390x844) fully covers the round support button support-chat-toggle (700-756px) while it's shown. Raise the banner above the FAB (e.g. bottom calc(9.5rem+safe-area)) or hide/shift the FAB while the banner is visible.
Tap targets below 44px: number-card-N-switch-forwarding/ivr/hours/fax are 32px tall at 390 (pricing-feature-*-more on landing 20px).

issues: renewals-row-N-toggle turns auto-renew off immediately with no confirm dialog (review brief expected one). Not clicked in testing to avoid changing data; consider ask() before turning renewal off.

action_items: mobile-app.css: include [role=alertdialog][aria-modal=true] (+ its backdrop parent) in bottom-sheet + handle rules so confirm-dialog becomes a sheet
Add civr-keep-table to sip-compare-table (pages/sip/Plans.js) and plan-compare-table (pages/landing/PlanTable.js)
mobile-app.css: td > * { min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere } to stop admin Users overflow (scrollWidth 603 at 390/412)
Card td layout: grid with value children stacked in column 2 (multi-child cells scatter today)
Palette sheet: add top padding so the grab handle shows
Install banner overlaps support-chat-toggle FAB; move one of them
Optional: 44px min-height for number-card quick switches; confirm before turning auto-renew off
critical_code_review_comments: Sheet CSS keys off role=dialog+aria-modal or Radix data-state; custom alertdialogs (confirm.js) are missed
Global `.civr table:not(.civr-keep-table)` conversion also hits landing/SIP comparison matrices which should stay tables; opt-out needed there
Tables without <thead> (e.g. admin-user-transactions) get no data-label, cells become unlabelled flex rows
InstallBanner checks isPhone() only once at 15s; Android without beforeinstallprompt shows nothing (expected)

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (core checks pass; 2 high + 1 medium + 4 low issues)
